text:
marta: quick problem spotted in last two DPs: midway through sprint they ask for extra model variants and data access. need a lightweight "scope-lock" flow.
kevin: agree. idea: intake -> automatic scoring -> path assignment (quick/beta/pilot) -> scope lock sign-off. lock prevents new feature asks without re-score.
rachel: +1. also require partners to commit to a minimum feedback cadence and a prompt escrow (even a small sample) otherwise we can't run evals.
devon: propose scoring keys: integration complexity (1-5), data sensitivity (0-3), infra change (0/1), expected qps (numeric). lambda outputs numeric score + path enum.
ops-bot: will add rule: any mention of "on-prem" or "VPC" triggers security & legal tags and pauses auto-assign.
kevin: scoring sketch (pseudo):
```
score = 0
score += (integration_complexity - 1) # 0..4
score += data_sensitivity * 2  # 0,2,4,6
if infra_change: score += 3
if expected_qps >= 200: score += 2
# interpret: <=2 => quick, 3-6 => beta, >=7 => pilot
```
marta: for quick path (<=2): owner assigned, sample prompts required, smoke test, docs snippet, 1-week pilot with partner.
rachel: for beta: 2-4 partners during beta, perf targets, cost estimates, monitoring + alerts, evaluation plan (prompt sets + human review pass rate).
devon: pilot: SLA discussion, dedicated capacity estimate, legal DPA draft if needed, rollback runbook.
kevin: acceptance criteria examples: human_pass_rate >= 0.75 on core prompts, latency_p95 <= 800ms, cost_per_1k under agreed threshold, monitoring pipeline sampling at 1%.
marta: add a "scope-lock" step: once PD+ENG sign-off, create a ticket flagged "scope-locked". Any change requires re-submission and re-score; emergency exceptions go through a triage meeting.
ops-bot: automation list: (1) scoring lambda attached to form, (2) auto-tag for security/legal, (3) create tracker card with score + path, (4) ability to add "scope-locked" label.
legal-bot: note: pilot path touching customer data requires pre-pilot DPA conversation. please collect data residency in intake.
rachel: outreach template suggestion (short):
"Hi {name},
Thanks for wanting to partner on {feature}. Quick asks: 1) one-line problem statement, 2) expected peak qps, 3) data residency, 4) sample prompts (or opt-out), 5) preferred timeline. We'll triage in 48h and propose a path.
We ask partners to join 2 feedback sessions during beta. NDA link available if needed.
Best, Redwood DP team"
kevin: small incentive note: standard package = $X credits + co-marketing. pilot tier gets higher credits + engineering timebox. include option in intake form.
devon: health score idea for post-launch (internal): combine pass_rate, hallucination_rate, latency, and usage trend. simple normalized formula and thresholds green/watch/red. if red -> auto-roll back or route to hosted fallback.
marta: rollback template for comms to partner: short note, expected mitigation steps, and ETA to re-check. we should keep partners in the loop.
rachel: telemetry to collect at launch: human pass rate sample (daily), hallucination flags, latency p95, token cost/1k, DP CSAT at day 14. set alerts for pass_rate drop >10% or cost rise >25%.
ops-bot: reminder: i'll post a follow-up in #product in 6 business days to check progress.
kevin: next steps: (1) marta to draft the one-pager + outreach copy, (2) devon to build scoring lambda, (3) rachel to define acceptance thresholds and health calc, (4) ops to wire automation and tags. ETA for MVP: 9 business days.
marta: i'll own the runbook and the scope-lock ticket template. will post draft here by EOD Thurs.
kevin: I'll pair with devon on the lambda. devon, can you estimate eng hours?
devon: rough: 1 day for lambda + tests, 1 day for form glue, 0.5 day for ticket creation; call it 2.5 days.
marta: perfect. goal: reduce mid-sprint scope churn by 60% and standardize DP expectations. thanks team.
